mapper.select: SELECT task_id, dataset_id, sheet_id, analysis_goal, expected_outputs_json, column_overrides_json, created_at, updated_at FROM data_analysis_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT task.id AS task_id, task.workspace_id, task.connection_id, task.title AS task_title, task.status AS task_status, dataset.id AS dataset_id, dataset.workspace_id AS dataset_workspace_id, dataset.name AS dataset_name, dataset.format AS dataset_format, dataset.status AS dataset_status, dataset_sheet.id AS sheet_id, dataset_sheet.sheet_name, dataset_sheet.row_count, dataset_sheet.column_count, data_analysis_task.analysis_goal, data_analysis_task.expected_outputs_json, data_analysis_task.column_overrides_json FROM data_analysis_task JOIN task ON task.id = data_analysis_task.task_id JOIN dataset ON dataset.id = data_analysis_task.dataset_id JOIN dataset_sheet ON dataset_sheet.id = data_analysis_task.sheet_id AND dataset_sheet.dataset_id = dataset.id WHERE task.id = #{taskId} AND task.module_type = 'DATA_ANALYSIS'

SELECT dataset.id AS dataset_id, dataset.workspace_id, dataset.name AS dataset_name, dataset.format AS dataset_format, dataset.status AS dataset_status, dataset.row_count AS dataset_row_count, dataset.column_count AS dataset_column_count, dataset_sheet.id AS sheet_id, dataset_sheet.sheet_name, dataset_sheet.row_count AS sheet_row_count, dataset_sheet.column_count AS sheet_column_count FROM dataset LEFT JOIN dataset_sheet ON dataset_sheet.id = #{sheetId} AND dataset_sheet.dataset_id = dataset.id WHERE dataset.id = #{datasetId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE data_analysis_task SET dataset_id = #{datasetId}, sheet_id = #{sheetId}, analysis_goal = #{analysisGoal}, expected_outputs_json = #{expectedOutputsJson}, column_overrides_json = #{columnOverridesJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
